feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is claimed for it. Evidence: iteration 7 (mass 0.5 kg, wheel_track 0.09 m, y 0.07 m) scored 400.0, the best so far. The oval held at 17/20 with steering_oscillation 0.30 and max_error 0.039 m. s-bend finished 2/20 with line-loss 1.4 and max_error 0.062 m. Slalom stayed at 0/20 with line-loss 1.95. Iterations 2 and 3 showed that span and footprint changes hurt, iteration 4 showed that forward position helped only the oval, and iterations 5 to 7 showed that narrowing and mass changes gave only small gains. Geometry on the sharp tracks is therefore near its limit, and the Integrator is testing controller response (kp and kd) with geometry held. Decision rules for the next race: (a) If s-bend line-loss falls to 1.0 or below and the oval holds at 16/20 or better, keep geometry as it is and the controller response is the lever. (b) If s-bend line-loss stays at 1.3 or more and the oval holds, the remaining gap is controller response on the sharpest bend, so do not change geometry further. (c) If the oval falls below about 14/20 or steering_oscillation rises above 0.35 with low max_error, the mass or narrowing is contributing to jitter, so return mass to 0.7 kg.
requested_changes: Hold wheel_track 0.09 m, span ±0.03 m at 0.015 m spacing, sensor y 0.07 m, footprint 0.012 m, wheel_radius 0.03 m and mass 0.5 kg. Evidence: iteration 7 scored 400.0 and every geometry change since iteration 4 has been flat or negative on the sharp tracks.

If the oval falls below about 14/20 or steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35 with low max_error at 0.5 kg, return mass to 0.7 kg. Evidence: iteration 6 at 0.7 kg held oval oscillation at 0.30, so a rise would show the lighter body is jittery.

If s-bend stays at about 1.3 line-loss with max_error near 0.06 m after the controller change, stop geometry tests on the sharp tracks and do not narrow below 0.09 m. Evidence: span, footprint, forward position and wheel_track tests (iterations 2 to 6) have not moved s-bend line-loss below 1.3.
